question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Protest
solution:
The correct answer is **"Support."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Protest"** means to express disagreement or disapproval, while support means to agree with or approve of something. ((विशेषतः सार्वजनिक) विरोध प्रदर्शन करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Students have been **protesting**__ against the government’s decision.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, **support** is the most appropriate antonym of **protest**.
 
• **"Suppor****t"** means to help somebody by saying that you agree with him/her/it, and sometimes giving practical help such as money. (किसी को (सहमति के आधार पर) समर्थन देना या किसी की (धन देकर) सहायता करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *Several large companies are **supporting**__ the project.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Notice"** means to become aware of something. (किसी बात को देखना और सतर्क हो जाना)
 
• **"Provide"** means to give or supply something. (किसी को कुछ देना या प्रयोग के लिए उपलब्‍ध कराना; किसी वस्‍तु की आपूर्ति)
 
• **"Assert"** means to state or declare with confidence. (स्‍पष्‍ट रूप से और बलपूर्वक कुछ कहना)

30:Tbda,

The correct answer is **"Beseech."**
